sources.snippet: Audio Event Triage Baseline Baseline Model Model Description This repository contains a small, transparent prototype model for Operations teams need an explainable starting point for classifying alarms, machinery noise, and speech-like events. The model combines per-label token weights with IDF-weighted evidence retrieval.
